    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends complaining about the web shops"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockActionsJoin" name="Join stock actions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StockActionsHandled" name="Stock actions handled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_IdentifyParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyParts" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveQuotes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveQuotes" targetRef="Task_AllocateParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_AllocateParts" targetRef="Task_CreateShopLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_CreateShopLists" targetRef="Task_SendInitialOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialOrders" targetRef="Event_FirstDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Event_FirstDelivery" targetRef="Task_StartBuilding"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Event_FurtherDelivery" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockThresholds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelow5" name="Stock below 5" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock < 5</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelow3" name="Stock below 3" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock < 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockZero" name="Stock is zero" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock = 0</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockNoAction" name="No threshold applies" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheapReorderToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FastReorderToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmailToJoin" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin" targetRef="End_StockActionsHandled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
